description: This file defines the `OpenClawChatTransportEvent` enum and the `OpenClawChatTransport` protocol, along with default method implementations for the protocol. It specifies the interface for chat transport mechanisms, including methods for sending messages, managing sessions, and handling events.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Asynchronously requests chat history for a given session key, returning a payload.

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of chat model choices.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message with optional attachments and returns a response.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Asynchronously aborts a specific run within a session.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Asynchronously lists active chat sessions, optionally limited.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets the model for a specific chat session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Sets the thinking level for a chat session.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the transport, returning a boolean.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous stream of chat transport events.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the active session key for the transport (default implementation does nothing).

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a session; default implementation throws an error indicating not supported.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a session; default implementation throws an error indicating not supported.
